## What changes?

Describe the reader problem or protocol behavior being changed.

## Scope

- [ ] Editorial/navigation/build only; protocol meaning is unchanged.
- [ ] Protocol meaning changes; link the applicable algorithm/field decisions.

## Sources and review

Identify the owning source paths and explain any compatibility impact.
For documentation, check the generated preview and source links; do not edit HTML.
For protocol changes, update definitions and their required corpus together.
Do not treat client deployment as a prerequisite for reviewing the protocol design.
